# Shucon MedAI

> Shucon MedAI builds healthcare AI agents and a connected hospital operations platform for hospitals, nursing homes, hospital groups and diagnostic centres in India and the UAE. Agents detect revenue leakage, move insurance claims forward, handle patient calls, and tell every stakeholder what needs to happen next. They run over existing hospital software or natively on the Shucon hospital management system. Founded by Saksham Gupta, a former Microsoft engineer on the core Microsoft AI Copilot team.

## AI agents
- [Healthcare AI agents overview](https://shuconmedai.com/ai-agents/): All Shucon MedAI agent suites and how they work together.
- [Revenue leakage detection agents](https://shuconmedai.com/agents/revenue-leakage/): Reconcile billing, pharmacy, inventory, cancellations and claims to find and recover lost hospital revenue.
- [Insurance claim and TPA agents](https://shuconmedai.com/agents/insurance-claims/): Pre-authorization, documentation readiness, payer query follow-up and denial prevention.
- [Patient engagement voice agents](https://shuconmedai.com/agents/patient-engagement/): AI voice agents for incoming and outgoing patient calls, appointments, follow-ups and OPD-to-IPD conversion.
- [Stakeholder action agents](https://shuconmedai.com/agents/stakeholder-action/): Prioritised next actions for leadership, finance, operations, nursing and pharmacy.
- [Custom healthcare AI agents](https://shuconmedai.com/custom-healthcare-ai/): Agents built around an organization's own SOPs, systems and approvals.

## Platform
- [Hospital management system (HMS)](https://shuconmedai.com/platform/hospital-management-system/): OPD, IPD, EMR, billing, pharmacy, inventory, lab, radiology, OT, insurance and analytics.
- [Diagnostic centre, lab and radiology software](https://shuconmedai.com/solutions/diagnostics-centres/): Bookings, samples, Shucon's own LIS, RIS and PACS integrated with billing, reporting and referrals.
- [AI for hospitals in the UAE](https://shuconmedai.com/uae-hospital-ai/)
- [What is HMIS? Full form and modules](https://shuconmedai.com/hmis/): Hospital Management Information System explained, HMIS for clinics, HMIS and LIMS.
- [What is PACS? Full form in radiology](https://shuconmedai.com/pacs/): Picture Archiving and Communication System explained, PACS vs RIS, DICOM, choosing a PACS, and Shucon's PACS with integrated RIS, LIS and billing.
- [What is a radiology information system (RIS)?](https://shuconmedai.com/ris/): RIS functions, workflow, RIS vs PACS, choosing a RIS, and Shucon's RIS with integrated PACS, LIS and billing.
- [What is a laboratory information system (LIS)?](https://shuconmedai.com/lis/): LIS and LIMS full forms, LIS functions, pathology lab software, HMIS LIMS integration, and Shucon's LIS with integrated RIS, PACS and billing.
- [Hospital billing software](https://shuconmedai.com/hospital-billing-software/): OPD, IPD, pharmacy, lab and radiology billing, packages, TPA claims and approval controls on one record.

- [Bed Turnover Rate: Formula, Interval and What It Tells You](https://shuconmedai.com/blog/bed-turnover-rate.html): Bed turnover rate = discharges ÷ available beds. Learn the formula, the bed turnover interval, a worked example and what the rate indicates.
- [How to Choose Hospital Management Software: A Buyer's Checklist](https://shuconmedai.com/blog/how-to-choose-hospital-management-software.html): How to choose hospital management software: map your workflows, make vendors demo real cases, compare the true cost and plan a phased rollout.
- [Charge Capture in Hospitals: Why Services Go Unbilled and How to Fix It](https://shuconmedai.com/blog/charge-capture-in-hospitals.html): Charge capture means every billable service reaches the final bill. See why services go unbilled, a worked INR example and the controls that fix it.
- [Cashless Claim Process in Hospitals: Step-by-Step Guide](https://shuconmedai.com/blog/cashless-claim-process-hospital.html): The cashless claim process in hospitals, step by step: eligibility, pre-authorisation, approvals, discharge and claim submission, with TPA desk controls.
- [Hospital KPIs: 25 Metrics Every Hospital Administrator Should Track](https://shuconmedai.com/blog/hospital-kpis-list.html): 25 hospital KPIs with owners: financial, bed utilisation, insurance claims, revenue leakage and patient flow metrics, plus how to build a KPI dashboard.
- [AI Agents in Healthcare: What They Are and How Hospitals Use Them](https://shuconmedai.com/blog/ai-agents-in-healthcare.html): What AI agents in healthcare are, how they differ from chatbots, and practical hospital use cases, with the human oversight, risks and rollout steps to plan.
- [OPD to IPD Conversion Ratio: Formula, Benchmarks and How to Improve It](https://shuconmedai.com/blog/opd-to-ipd-conversion-ratio.html): OPD to IPD conversion rate formula with a worked example, indicative benchmarks and ethical ways to improve admission follow-up in hospitals.
- [Hospital Management System Modules: The Complete List for Hospitals and Nursing Homes](https://shuconmedai.com/blog/hospital-management-system-modules.html): The complete list of hospital management system modules: OPD, IPD, billing, pharmacy, lab, inventory, TPA and MIS, and which to roll out first.
- [Bed Occupancy Rate Formula: How to Calculate Hospital Occupancy and Use It](https://shuconmedai.com/blog/bed-occupancy-rate-formula.html): Bed occupancy rate = occupied bed days ÷ available bed days × 100. See a worked monthly example, which beds to count and how to read the result.
- [TPA Claim Rejection Reasons and How Hospitals Can Prevent Them](https://shuconmedai.com/blog/tpa-claim-rejection-reasons.html): The common reasons TPAs and insurers reject hospital claims, from incomplete papers to bill mismatches, and stage-wise steps to prevent them.
- [What is ALOS in a Hospital? Average Length of Stay Formula, Example and How to Improve It](https://shuconmedai.com/blog/alos-average-length-of-stay.html): ALOS means Average Length of Stay: inpatient days ÷ discharges. See the formula, a worked example, indicative benchmarks and safe ways to reduce it.
